title: Early-Payment Discount on Fleet Invoices — Service Accounts and Repair Orders Commercial Terms
content:
**Scope.** For a fleet invoice paid in full, this policy sets the early-payment discount, and only for such an invoice; it is still credited as an early-payment discount credit, rounded half up to the cent, and a partial payment earns none. A fleet invoice is a repair order on a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account at Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30.

**Prerequisite.** The early-payment discount on an invoice is not fixed until the records carry the comeback credit owed on every repeat repair on that invoice that falls inside the repair warranty and whose original repair line carries a customer-pay labor charge.

**What is booked.** The discount is booked against the invoice's latest customer-pay labor charge as an early-payment discount credit, and it lowers the amount owed on the account.

## Tool: `credit_early_payment_discount_b0e7362c`
**Capability.** Credits the early-payment discount on a fleet invoice: one early-payment discount credit against a named labor charge of the invoice's repair order, dated today, lowering the amount owed on the service account by the credit.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `credit_early_payment_discount_b0e7362c` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_account_id` | Reference number of the fleet customer's service account, as returned by the service account lookup | Id |
| `repair_order_number` | Repair order number of the invoice, copied from the repair order lines returned by the ledger lookup | Verbatim, character for character, no normalisation |
| `line_letter` | Concern line of the labor charge the discount is booked against | One of `A` (first concern line), `B`, `C`, `D`, `E`, `F`, `G`, `H` (eighth), or `not_applicable` (a charge belonging to the repair order as a whole); it must be the concern line of the charge named by `source_line_id` |
| `source_line_id` | Reference number of the invoice's labor charge the discount is booked against, as returned by the ledger lookup | Id of a labor charge of the same service account and repair order |
| `credit_amount` | The early-payment discount | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (further digits are rounded half up), greater than zero, plain decimal notation with no currency sign, separators or exponent |

**Return.** A one-line receipt beginning with the word Credited, naming the credit reference, the repair order number and concern line, the discount amount and the resulting amount owed. A string beginning with Error is returned, and nothing is booked, when `credit_amount` is not a plain decimal amount greater than zero after rounding, when `line_letter` is outside the set, when `source_line_id` does not name a labor charge of this service account and repair order, or when `line_letter` is not that charge's concern line.
